{{Quote|We don't have to take your whole gang, ''Shorran Dak''&hellip; We only have to get ''you''!''"<br />"''A fine ''epitaph'', Jedi! ''Finish them'', boys!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and Shorran Dak|<ref name="Mask of Iron" />}}
'''Shorran Dak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] who acted as the leader of the [[Black Talon Gang]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Dak was contacted by the rogue [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Blayne]] regarding a new type of [[Blayne's liquid metal|weaponry]] that the scientist had developed, and Dak and his gang set a course for [[Blayne's asteroid base]] aboard their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Talon's Wing]]'', hoping to be able to negotiate a deal to procure the weaponry. However, ''Talon's Wing'' was [[Mission to Blayne's asteroid base|boarded]] en-route by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who captured Dak and his gang and dumped them in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], which was to be retrieved by [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]]. The Jedi then journeyed to Blayne's facility in Dak's place, with Kenobi posing as Dak and Skywalker as his [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]].<ref name="Mask of Iron" />
